finalText:
Build is clean now. Two real bugs hiding in the warnings:

1. **src/core/options.js** — accessing `options.retries` when the new bundler sends `options.retryCount`. Changed to read the right property name.

2. **src/net/retryPolicy.js** — throwing an error when `backoffEnabled` is undefined, but the new config loader leaves unset flags undefined instead of false. Changed to return false for that case.

The remaining 8 warnings are deprecations from the dependency bump itself — those are noise.
